speaker: Doctor
text: Did you notice any blood in your urine, or is the pain on one side or both? Also, have you experienced any nausea or vomiting along with these symptoms?

text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see you developed a rash with amoxicillin that resolved after switching to cephalexin; did you experience any burning or difficulty when urinating? Also, is the flank pain localized to one side or both?

speaker: Patient
